Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 28% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 3 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 26% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information by HOT and exported in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, GeoPackage). The dataset contains approximately 841.5 thousand buildings with metadata on data currency and AI-mapped coverage estimates, providing a spatial inventory of building assets for exposure assessment in Moldova.
